summary.zh: 起草合同、提案、SOW 与 NDA 等文书
summary.en: Drafts contracts, proposals, SOWs and NDAs

description.zh: 按美国、欧盟、英国或 DACH 地区的常见做法，起草自由职业合同、项目提案、工作说明书、保密协议和主服务协议，输出结构化的 Markdown 并说明如何转成 Word。适合接单、外包或合作洽谈前准备文书。内容不构成法律意见，正式签署前仍需律师确认。
description.en: Drafts freelance contracts, proposals, statements of work, NDAs and MSAs for US, EU, UK and DACH jurisdictions in structured Markdown, with steps to convert to Word. Useful before a new engagement. Not legal advice.
